title: Motivic-Galois reading of the Kummer filtration
html:
Remark. Motivic-Galois reading of the Kummer filtration

Motivic-Galois reading. The Kummer filtration on H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m) is the restriction to the cyclotomic Galois subgroup \mathrm{Gal}(\mathbb{Q}(\mu_\infty)/\mathbb{Q}) of the motivic-Galois filtration on the motivic substrate. At each finite place p \nmid \chi(A) of \mathbb{Q} (adelic substrate), the realization \rho_p projects \kappa_0 to a non-trivial Frobenius character in H^1_{\mathrm{Gal}}(\mathrm{Gal}(\bar{\mathbb{Q}}_p/\mathbb{Q}_p),\,\mu_n(1)) through the cyclotomic ideal \mathbb{Z}[q]/\Phi_n(q). The perpetual obstruction guarantees that the motivic-Galois character of the Frobenius–Hopf substrate is non-trivial in \mathrm{Hom}(\chi_n, 1) for every n. This realises perpetuity at every cyclotomic place.

The Frobenius character of \kappa_0 is non-trivial at every finite place p \nmid \chi(A). We establish this in the motivic perpetual obstruction (proved via Route A: prime-ideal collapse, C = a_0(-1) + 2 \cdot a_1(-1)). The divisibility properties of the Kummer tower follow as corollaries at each adelic place.
